outcome: Indications for cesarean delivery (fetal indications, maternal factors, stage 1 arrest, stage 2 arrest, other)
cohort: 1659 women (480 with no FGM and 1179 with FGM) who underwent trial of labor resulting in cesarean delivery at 28 obstetric centers in six African countries.
finding: Among women without a clear medical indication for cesarean delivery, FGM was associated with cesarean delivery being performed for maternal factors, stage 1 arrest, stage 2 arrest, or other factors, rather than fetal factors.
mod_finding: FGM status was associated with specific indications for cesarean delivery, particularly maternal factors and arrest disorders, when clear medical indications were absent.
cross-section timing: Data collected between November 1, 2001, and March 31, 2003
